1	# SkipStepOptimizer:loss spike 检测与梯度裁剪
2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	学完本讲,你应该能够:
6	
7	1. 解释 **loss spike**(损失尖峰)为什么危险,以及 OLMo-core 用「整步跳过」而非「更强裁剪」来应对的理由。
8	2. 读懂 [SkipStepOptimizer](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/skip_step_optimizer.py#L12) 基类的滚动窗口统计与 \(k\sigma\) 判据,理解 `step_factor`「乘 0 而不是提前 return」的设计。
9	3. 掌握梯度裁剪在 OLMo-core 中的三个实现位置(基类 TrainModule、TransformerTrainModule、OLMoDDPOptimizer),以及 `latest_loss` / `latest_grad_norm` 必须在 `step()` 之前设置好的时序契约。
10	4. 会用 `grad_debug.py` 的 `debug_nan_inf_grad_norm()` 定位产生 NaN/Inf 梯度的具体参数。
11	
12	本讲是优化器单元的第三讲,聚焦「训练稳定性防线」:上一讲的调度器决定学习率*应该多大*,本讲决定*异常步要不要执行*。
13	
14	## 2. 前置知识
15	
16	### 2.1 loss spike 是什么
17	
18	大模型预训练中,个别 batch(坏数据、极端长序列、数值事故)会产生远超正常水平的 loss 和梯度。单步巨梯度注入 Adam 的动量 \(m_t\) 与二阶矩 \(v_t\) 后,会连续污染后续几十步的更新方向,轻则 loss 曲线出现鼓包,重则梯度爆炸成 NaN 导致训练崩溃。这种现象叫 **loss spike**(损失尖峰)。
19	
20	### 2.2 梯度裁剪(gradient clipping)回顾
21	
22	最常用的 **按范数裁剪** 是:先算出所有参数梯度的全局 \(L_2\) 范数 \(\lVert g \rVert_2\),若超过阈值则整体缩放:
23	
24	\[
25	c = \min\left(1,\ \frac{\text{max\_grad\_norm}}{\lVert g \rVert_2 + 10^{-6}}\right),\qquad g \leftarrow c \cdot g
26	\]
27	
28	裁剪把单步梯度*压小*,但被压过的更新仍然会执行;跳步(skip step)则把可疑的整步*完全放弃*。两者互补:裁剪是常态防线,跳步是极端情况的安全气囊。
29	
30	### 2.3 host-device 同步
31	
32	GPU 上的张量如果被 `.item()`、`float()` 或 Python `if` 读取,程序必须等 GPU 把值算完传回 CPU,这叫 **host-device sync**,会让流水线停顿。本讲会反复看到一个设计动机:*把「是否跳步」的判断结果保留为 GPU 上的 0/1 张量,直接乘进更新公式,从而避免同步*。
33	
34	### 2.4 滚动窗口与 \(k\sigma\) 判据
35	
36	「多大算异常?」一种相对判据:维护最近 \(W\) 步 loss(和梯度范数)的滚动窗口,当前值若超过窗口均值加 \(k\) 倍标准差,即判为异常。默认 \(W=128\)、\(k=6\),即经典的「6σ 事件」。
37	
38	### 2.5 前置讲义
39	
40	- u5-l1:OptimConfig 家族、`build()` 流程、参数组(param_groups)概念。
41	- u5-l2:调度器如何在 `optim_step` 中被调用(本讲的时序图会用到)。
42	
43	## 3. 本讲源码地图
44	
45	| 文件 | 作用 |
46	| --- | --- |
47	| `src/olmo_core/optim/skip_step_optimizer.py` | `SkipStepOptimizer` 基类:滚动窗口、`get_step_factor()` 判定 |
48	| `src/olmo_core/optim/adamw.py` | `adamw_step()` 把 `step_factor` 织进 AdamW 公式;`SkipStepAdamW` 与 `SkipStepAdamWConfig` |
49	| `src/olmo_core/optim/lion.py` | `SkipStepLion`:另一个跳步实现(基类文档点名参考它) |
50	| `src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py` | `OLMoDDPOptimizer`:MoE 场景下裁剪+跳步一体化的分布式融合优化器,也是 `grad_debug` 的唯一调用方 |
51	| `src/olmo_core/optim/grad_debug.py` | `debug_nan_inf_grad_norm()`:非有限梯度范数的诊断工具 |
52	| `src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py` | `TransformerTrainModule.optim_step()`:裁剪→记录→step 的时序契约 |
53	| `src/olmo_core/train/train_module/train_module.py` | 基类 `TrainModule.optim_step()`:最朴素的裁剪位置 |
54	| `src/test/optim/skip_step_optimizer_test.py` | 跳步行为单元测试(CPU 可跑) |
55	| `src/scripts/official/OLMo2/OLMo-2-0325-32B-train.py` | 官方脚本中 `SkipStepAdamWConfig` 的真实用法 |
56	
57	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
58	
59	本讲拆成四个最小模块:**SkipStepOptimizer 基类** → **SkipStepAdamW 的公式织入** → **梯度裁剪的位置与时序契约** → **grad_debug 诊断工具**。
60	
61	### 4.1 SkipStepOptimizer 基类:滚动统计与跳步判定
62	
63	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
64	
65	`SkipStepOptimizer` 是一个**优化器包装基类**(直接继承 `torch.optim.optimizer.Optimizer`):任何优化器只要在更新公式里乘上它提供的 `step_factor`(1=执行,0=跳过),就获得了「检测到异常步则整步放弃」的能力。
66	
67	它解决两个问题:
68	
69	1. **判定**:当前 loss / 梯度范数相对近期历史是否异常(均值 + \(k\sigma\) 上界,单边检测——只有*过大*才跳,过小不管)。
70	2. **无同步执行**:判定结果是一个留在设备上的 0/1 浮点张量,子类把它乘进每一步更新,数学上等价于「这步什么都没做」,却不用把布尔值搬回 CPU、也不用 `if` 分支。
71	
72	为什么不直接 `if is_bad: return`?因为 `is_bad` 要从 GPU 张量读出真值就必须 host-device sync;而且在多卡训练中,各 rank 若因时序差异拿到不同分支,参数会立刻失同步。让*每个 rank 基于相同的全局统计*算出相同的 `step_factor`(0 或 1),再以乘法施加,是确定且无同步的。
73	
74	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
75	
76	```
77	每个训练步(子类 step() 内部):
78	1. step_factor = self.get_step_factor()
79	     ├─ len(_losses) < max(2, W//2)?  → 返回 1.0(统计未热身,不检测)
80	     ├─ 用 _losses[:-1](不含当前值)算 loss 的 mean / std
81	     ├─ 若有 _grad_norms:同样算 grad_norm 的 mean / std,
82	     │    step_factor = (loss ≤ μℓ + kσℓ) AND (gnorm ≤ μg + kσg)
83	     └─ 否则只看 loss 一条
84	2. self._step_skipped = 1 - step_factor(供监控读取)
85	3. 把 step_factor 乘进全部更新公式(见 4.2)
86	```
87	
88	判定公式(双变量版):
89	
90	\[
91	\text{step\_factor} = \mathbb{1}\!\left[\ell_t \le \mu^\ell_{t} + k\,\sigma^\ell_{t}\right] \;\wedge\; \mathbb{1}\!\left[g_t \le \mu^g_{t} + k\,\sigma^g_{t}\right]
92	\]
93	
94	其中 \(\mu_t, \sigma_t\) 取自**剔除当前值后**的滚动窗口(`_losses[:-1]`),窗口至多 \(W\) 条;任一变量越界即跳步。注意热身门槛:至少积累 \(\max(2, W/2)\) 个 loss 才开始检测,默认 \(W=128\) 意味着前 64 步无条件执行。
95	
96	#### 4.1.3 源码精读
97	
98	**构造函数只存参数和两个历史列表**。[skip_step_optimizer.py:L33-L45](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/skip_step_optimizer.py#L33-L45):`rolling_interval_length`(默认 128)和 `sigma_factor`(默认 6)是仅有的两个旋钮;`_losses` / `_grad_norms` 存的是 **GPU 张量**(不是 float),这是无同步设计的第一步。
99	
100	**`latest_loss` 是带副作用的 property**。[skip_step_optimizer.py:L59-L70](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/skip_step_optimizer.py#L59-L70):对 `optim.latest_loss = loss` 赋值实际是把张量 append 进 `_losses`,并把列表裁到 `W + 1` 条。多保留 1 条是刻意的——`get_step_factor()` 里用 `[:-1]` 剔除当前值后,历史恰好是 \(W\) 条。`latest_grad_norm` 同构([L72-L83](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/skip_step_optimizer.py#L72-L83));不设梯度范数则退化为纯 loss 判定。
101	
102	**核心判定 `get_step_factor()`**。[skip_step_optimizer.py:L85-L109](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/skip_step_optimizer.py#L85-L109) 值得逐行读:
103	
104	- [L94-L95](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/skip_step_optimizer.py#L94-L95):热身门槛,统计不足直接给 `1.0` 张量。
105	- [L97](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/skip_step_optimizer.py#L97):`torch.std_mean(torch.stack(self._losses[:-1]))` 一次算出窗口均值与标准差,全程不下 GPU。
106	- [L102-L105](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/skip_step_optimizer.py#L102-L105):`torch.logical_and` 组合 loss 与梯度范数两个单边不等式,转 `.float()` 得 0/1。
107	- 整个方法被 [`@torch._dynamo.disable()`](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/skip_step_optimizer.py#L85) 装饰:当优化器 step 被 `torch.compile` 编译(见 u5-l1 的 `OptimConfig.compile`)时,这个函数仍按 eager 执行——因为窗口长度会随训练变化,把它编进图会导致反复重编译。
108	
109	**`step_skipped` 是反向读数**。[skip_step_optimizer.py:L111-L116](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/skip_step_optimizer.py#L111-L116) 返回 `1 - get_step_factor()`,即「1 = 这步被跳过」,供训练循环记录成监控指标。
110	
111	**使用契约写在类文档里**。[skip_step_optimizer.py:L18-L25](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/skip_step_optimizer.py#L18-L25):调用方必须在 `step()` **之前**设置 `latest_loss` 和 `latest_grad_norm`;`TransformerTrainModule` 会在优化器是 `SkipStepOptimizer` 子类时自动完成(时序见 4.3)。

113	> 细节提醒:当窗口历史恰好只有 1 个样本时(如把 `rolling_interval_length` 设得很小做实验),`torch.std_mean` 的无偏标准差是 NaN,而与 NaN 的比较恒为 False,该步会被判为跳过。默认参数下热身门槛(\(\max(2, 64)\))保证了实际训练不会落入这种退化情形,但自己调小窗口做实验时要意识到这一点。

139	### 4.2 SkipStepAdamW:把 step_factor 织进更新公式
140	
141	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
142	
143	基类只负责*判定*;真正实现「跳过」的是子类。`SkipStepAdamW` 把标准 AdamW 更新公式的每一项都乘上 `step_factor`:
144	
145	- `step_factor = 0` 时,权重衰减系数变成 1、动量混合权重变成 0、更新量变成 0、内部 step 计数不前进——整步在数学上是**严格的 no-op**;
146	- `step_factor = 1` 时,公式还原为标准 AdamW。
147	
148	这种「软跳过」的代价只是几次逐元素乘法,换来零 host-device 同步与全 rank 行为一致。
149	
150	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
151	
152	单个参数的更新(记 \(f\) 为 step_factor,\(\beta_1,\beta_2\) 为 betas):
153	
154	\[
155	\begin{aligned}
156	p &\leftarrow p \big(1 - f \cdot \lambda \cdot \text{wd}\big) &&\text{解耦权重衰减}\\
157	m &\leftarrow m + f(1-\beta_1)(g - m) &&\text{一阶矩}\\
158	v &\leftarrow \big(1 - f(1-\beta_2)\big)v + f(1-\beta_2)\,g^2 &&\text{二阶矩}\\
159	p &\leftarrow p - f \cdot \frac{\lambda}{1-\beta_1^{s+1}} \cdot \frac{m}{\sqrt{v/(1-\beta_2^{s+1})} + \epsilon} &&\text{参数更新}\\
160	s &\leftarrow s + f &&\text{内部步计数}
161	\end{aligned}
162	\]
163	
164	注意 \(s\) 也乘 \(f\):被跳过的步不推进 Adam 的偏差校正时钟,保证后续 bias correction 语义连续。
165	
166	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
167	
168	**单参数版 `adamw_step()`**。[adamw.py:L12-L47](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/adamw.py#L12-L47)。关键三处:
169	
170	- [L29](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/adamw.py#L29):`p.mul_(1 - step_factor * (lr * weight_decay))` —— 衰减量乘 \(f\)。
171	- [L32-L34](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/adamw.py#L32-L34):一阶矩用 `lerp_`,插值权重是 \(f(1-\beta_1)\)(\(f=0\) 时 m 原样不动);二阶矩的衰减与新息同样乘 \(f\)。

210	### 4.3 梯度裁剪在哪里:optim_step 的时序契约
211	
212	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
213	
214	OLMo-core 的梯度裁剪**不是优化器的构造参数**,而是发生在 `TrainModule.optim_step()` 里、`optim.step()` 之前的独立一步。对跳步优化器而言,裁剪还顺带生产了检测器需要的第二路信号:`latest_grad_norm`。
215	
216	于是形成一条严格的时序契约:
217	
218	```
219	train_batch():
220	  前向 → loss.backward()
221	  若 optim 是 SkipStepOptimizer:
222	      先把 loss 跨 rank 归约成全局均值 → optim.latest_loss   ← 信号①
223	optim_step():
224	  ① 若设了 max_grad_norm:计算总梯度范数并裁剪
225	  ② 记录 "total grad norm" 指标
226	  ③ 若 optim 是 SkipStepOptimizer:optim.latest_grad_norm = 裁剪前范数  ← 信号②
227	  ④ 调度器为本步设定 lr(u5-l2)
228	  ⑤ optim.step()(内部用信号①②算 step_factor)
229	  ⑥ 记录 "step skipped" 指标
230	zero_grads():optim.zero_grad()
231	```
232	
233	要点:两个信号都必须在 `step()` 之前就位(基类文档的硬性要求);且 loss 必须是**全局**的——各 rank 拿本地 loss 判定会得出不同 `step_factor`,参数立即失同步。
234	
235	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
236	
237	裁剪本身的算法(与 2.2 公式一致):
238	
239	```
240	total_norm = ‖所有参数梯度‖₂(跨并行维度正确归约)
241	clip_coef = max_grad_norm / (total_norm + 1e-6)
242	所有梯度 ×= clamp(clip_coef, max=1.0)     ← 无条件乘,用 clamp 避免 if 同步
243	```
244	
245	分布式难点在「total_norm 怎么算才对」:分片(DTensor/FSDP)、复制、流水线各持有一部分梯度,必须先按分片平方和的局部和、再跨进程组归约,最后开方——TransformerTrainModule 与 OLMoDDPOptimizer 对此有各自实现。
246	
247	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
248	
249	**信号①:train_batch 里提前归约 loss**。[train_module.py:L502-L510](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L502-L510):`isinstance(self.optim, SkipStepOptimizer)` 分支中,先把 `ce_batch_loss` 除以各 rank 的 token 数因子、`dist.all_reduce` 求和再平均(注释写明「Need to reduce the loss right away for the SkipStepOptimizer」),然后才 `self.optim.latest_loss = ce_batch_loss`。普通优化器则走 [L512](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L512) 的延迟归约路径(`ReduceType.mean`,日志时才归约)——跳步优化器等不到那时。
250	
251	**时序契约的主战场 `optim_step()`**。[train_module.py:L583-L606](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L583-L606) 完整对应上面流程图的 ①-⑥:[L586-L591](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L586-L591) 裁剪并记录(注释强调范数已跨 rank 归约,指标 `reduce_type=None` 防止二次归约);[L592-L593](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L592-L593) 写入信号②;[L602-L604](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L602-L604) step 之后把 `optim.step_skipped` 记录为命名空间 `optim` 下的 **"step skipped" 指标**——训练日志里看到它变成 1,就知道检测器拦下了一步。
252	
253	**裁剪实现 `_clip_grad_norm()`**。[train_module.py:L683-L710](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L683-L710) 分两路:FSDP 模型直接委托 [`model.clip_grad_norm_`](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L686-L687)(FSDP 框架自己懂分片);否则用改编自 torchtitan 的两段式——`nn.utils.get_total_norm` 算范数([L694-L696](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L694-L696)),若是 DTensor 则 `full_tensor()` 归约([L704-L707](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L704-L707),注释说明这也是为了让 PP 场景下 `.item()` 拿到正确值),最后 `clip_grads_with_norm_` 施加裁剪([L709](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L709))。**返回的是裁剪前的总范数**——正好就是检测器要的梯度范数信号。
254	
255	**最朴素的对照组:基类 TrainModule**。[train_module.py:L390-L400](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/train_module.py#L390-L400) 只有一行 `nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.model.parameters(), self.max_grad_norm)` 然后直接 `optim.step()`——没有信号②、没有跳步指标,这就是「裁剪」与「裁剪+跳步」两种配置的差异全景。
256	
257	**优化器内裁剪:OLMoDDPOptimizer._clip_grad()**。[moe_optimizer.py:L1072-L1140](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py#L1072-L1140) 把裁剪搬进了优化器内部(它的 `step()` 在 [L1277-L1285](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py#L1277-L1285) 里依次:校验 loss 有限 → `_clip_grad()` → `self.latest_grad_norm = total_grad_norm` → `_step_foreach`)。函数开头的大段注释([L1073-L1087](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py#L1073-L1087))解释了为什么:优化器看到的模型已经被 PP/EP/DP 多维切过,范数必须按「分片量分桶归约、复制量直接取」的组合方式算([L1114-L1119](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py#L1114-L1119))。[L1131-L1138](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py#L1131-L1138) 的裁剪施加与 4.2 的软跳步同一手法:`clamp(clip_coef, max=1.0)` 后**无条件** `foreach_mul_`,注释明说是为了躲开 `if clip_coef < 1:` 带来的 CPU↔设备同步。

269	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
270	
271	**练习 1**:为什么 `TransformerTrainModule` 记录 `total grad norm` 指标时显式传 `reduce_type=None`?
272	
273	**答案**:因为 `_clip_grad_norm()` 返回的范数已经跨所有 rank 归约过(DTensor `full_tensor()` 或 FSDP 内部归约),每个 rank 手里的值相同;若再按指标系统做一次 mean 归约,等于把同一个数平均回自己,虽不出错但多余,而其他 reduce 语义则会算错。见 [train_module.py:L588-L591](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L588-L591) 的注释。
274	
275	**练习 2**:`max_grad_norm` 设为 `None`(不裁剪)时,跳步检测还能工作吗?
276	
277	**答案**:只能工作一半。`optim_step` 的裁剪分支整体跳过([L586](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L586) 的 `if self.max_grad_norm is not None`),`latest_grad_norm` 永远不会被设置,`get_step_factor()` 退化为纯 loss 判定(4.1 练习 3)。想要完整检测,必须开启裁剪——检测信号是裁剪的副产品。
278	
279	**练习 3**:OLMoDDPOptimizer 把裁剪放进优化器、TransformerTrainModule 把裁剪放在训练模块,两种放法各适合什么场景?
280	
281	**答案**:TransformerTrainModule 的放法适合「优化器是黑盒(torch 原生或 SkipStepAdamW)」的常规路径,裁剪用模型侧的通用工具完成;OLMoDDPOptimizer 自持 fp32 主权重与 DP/EP 分片梯度,只有它自己清楚每个分片的布局,范数计算与裁剪必须与梯度搬运(`_copy_model_grads_to_main_grads`)在同一个对象内完成,顺便也把 `latest_grad_norm` 的赋值([moe_optimizer.py:L1283](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py#L1283))内化成 `step()` 的一部分,契约不可能被调用方违反。
282	
283	### 4.4 grad_debug:定位非有限梯度的元凶参数
284	
285	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
286	
287	裁剪和跳步处理的是「太大」的梯度;最恶性的故障是 **NaN/Inf 梯度**——范数一旦非有限,`clip_coef` 变 NaN 会污染所有参数,训练基本报废。此时第一现场的问题是:*几百个参数里,是哪一个先坏的?*
288	
289	`grad_debug.py` 的 `debug_nan_inf_grad_norm()` 就是这个「事故调查员」:给定(节点本地的)总梯度范数,若它是有限的,函数**立即返回、零开销**;若非有限,则逐参数计算本地 \(L_2\) 范数与 \(L_\infty\) 范数(最大绝对值)、有限性标志,把非有限的「嫌犯」和范数最大的 Top-K「背景」一起打日志,可选地 `torch.save` 落盘供事后分析。
290	
291	它体现了一个性能模式:**延迟求值**——`component_norms` 和 `iter_local_grads` 两个参数是回调函数而非现成数据,只有确认要报警时才被调用,正常训练步不为诊断付任何代价。
292	
293	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
294	
295	```
296	debug_nan_inf_grad_norm(total_grad_norm_local, ...):
297	  1. rank 不在 ranks_filter 内 → 返回
298	  2. total_grad_norm_local 全有限 → 返回(常态,零成本)
299	  3. component_norms() → 各分桶(dp 复制/分片、ep 复制/分片)的本地范数
300	  4. 遍历 iter_local_grads() 的每个 (name, param_group, placements, grad):
301	       local_norm = ‖grad‖₂, max_abs = ‖grad‖∞
302	       任一非有限 → bad_entries(嫌犯列表)
303	       全部进 top_entries
304	  5. top_entries 按 local_norm 降序(非有限排最前)
305	  6. 可选:torch.save 完整报告到 dump_dir/rankXXX_stepYYYYYY_....pt
306	  7. log.error 输出:总数、components、BAD 行、Top 行
307	```
308	
309	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
310	
311	**零成本早退**。[grad_debug.py:L53-L58](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/grad_debug.py#L53-L58):rank 过滤(`rank_matches_filter`,`"all"`/`"*"` 或逗号分隔的编号表,见 [utils.py:L74-L83](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/utils.py#L74-L83))之后,一次 `torch.isfinite(...).all().item()` 判断:有限就直接返回——这正是文档字符串([L40-L43](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/grad_debug.py#L40-L43))所说「component_norms/iter_local_grads 只在决定报警后才被调用」的实现位置。
312	
313	**逐参数体检**。[grad_debug.py:L65-L92](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/grad_debug.py#L65-L92):对每个梯度算 `vector_norm(ord=2)`(本地范数)与 `ord=inf`(max_abs),用 `math.isfinite` 标注有限性([L71-L72](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/grad_debug.py#L71-L72));非有限者进 `bad_entries`,所有条目进 `top_entries`,排序时非有限值按 \(+\infty\) 置顶([L88-L90](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/grad_debug.py#L88-L90))。每条记录还带 param_group、DTensor placements、dtype、shape——这些都是定位「哪种并行布局下的哪类参数」的关键线索。
314	
315	**落盘与告警**。[grad_debug.py:L94-L107](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/grad_debug.py#L94-L107) 把报告存成 `.pt` 文件(文件名含 rank 与 step);[L109-L125](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/grad_debug.py#L109-L125) 用 `log.error` 输出 `BAD` 嫌犯行与 Top 范数行。[L109-L110](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/grad_debug.py#L109-L110) 的注释坦承一个已知取舍:`max_log_entries` 同时截断嫌犯列表,非有限参数特别多时日志会截断(完整数据仍在 dump 文件里)。
316	
317	**谁来调用它:优化器侧适配器**。[moe_optimizer.py:L1189-L1232](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py#L1189-L1232) 的 `_maybe_debug_nan_inf_grad_norm()` 是唯一调用方,它读四个**环境变量**当开关(代码注释也自我批评这偏离了库的 Config 中心约定,TODO 迁移):
318	
319	| 环境变量 | 作用 | 默认 |
320	| --- | --- | --- |
321	| `OLMO_DDP_DEBUG_NONFINITE_GRAD` | 总开关(`env_bool`) | 未设置(关) |
322	| `OLMO_DDP_DEBUG_NONFINITE_GRAD_TOPK` | Top 列表长度 | `20` |
323	| `OLMO_DDP_DEBUG_NONFINITE_GRAD_RANKS` | 哪些 rank 报告 | `all` |
324	| `OLMO_DEBUG_DUMP_DIR` | 报告落盘目录 | 未设置(只打日志) |
325	
326	调用点在 `_clip_grad()` 内部([moe_optimizer.py:L1121-L1127](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py#L1121-L1127)),紧挨着 `check_nan_inf_grad` 的异步有限性断言([L1128-L1129](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py#L1128-L1129)):断言负责「立刻炸出来」,诊断负责「留下遗书」。适配器传入的 `step` 用的是 trainer 的 `global_step` 而非优化器内部 step——因为跳步会让后者落后于前者,注释见 [L1209-L1211](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py#L1209-L1211),这也回扣了 4.2 的 `step_increment_bugfix`。

368	**练习 1**:为什么 `debug_nan_inf_grad_norm` 的 `component_norms` / `iter_local_grads` 参数设计成回调而不是普通字典/列表?

372	**练习 2**:生产训练中如何零改码启用这套诊断?
373	
374	**答案**:给 MoE/OLMoDDP 路径的训练进程设置环境变量后重启:`OLMO_DDP_DEBUG_NONFINITE_GRAD=1`,按需加 `OLMO_DDP_DEBUG_NONFINITE_GRAD_TOPK`(如 50)、`OLMO_DDP_DEBUG_NONFINITE_GRAD_RANKS=0,3`(只让个别 rank 报告,避免 N 卡刷屏)、`OLMO_DEBUG_DUMP_DIR=/path`(留全量证据)。开关解析见 [moe_optimizer.py:L1213-L1224](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py#L1213-L1224)。
375	
376	**练习 3**:跳步检测(4.1)能拦截 NaN 梯度吗?两者如何分工?
377	
378	**答案**:大概率拦不住,也不该指望它。NaN 与任何数的比较都是 False,`get_step_factor()` 会给出 0(跳过),看似拦住了;但 OLMoDDPOptimizer 路径在 `check_nan_inf_grad=True` 时会用 `_assert_finite_async` 在裁剪处直接断言失败([moe_optimizer.py:L1128-L1129](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py#L1128-L1129)),把 NaN 当*事故*而非*尖峰*处理。分工是:6σ 跳步对付「有限但异常大」的尖峰;有限性断言 + grad_debug 对付「已经非有限」的硬故障,后者需要人介入查根因(数据、lr、数值精度)。
379	
380	## 5. 综合实践
381	
382	**任务**:写一个 ~40 行的脚本,完整复现「正常训练 → 注入 loss spike → 跳步 → 恢复」的全过程,并把检测器的内部状态打印出来。这是本讲规格里代码实践任务的落地。
383	
384	以下为**示例代码**(待本地验证;CPU 即可运行,依赖 `olmo_core` 已按 u1-l2 安装):
385	
386	```python
387	"""skip_step_demo.py — 人为注入 loss spike,观察 SkipStepAdamW 的跳步行为。"""
388	import torch
389	from torch import nn
390	from olmo_core.optim import SkipStepAdamWConfig
391	
392	torch.manual_seed(0)
393	
394	class MyModel(nn.Module):                     # 与官方单测同款小模型
395	    def __init__(self):
396	        super().__init__()
397	        self.wte = nn.Embedding(1024, 16)
398	        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(16, 32)
399	        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(32, 16)
400	    def forward(self, x):
401	        return self.fc2(torch.relu(self.fc1(self.wte(x))))
402	
403	model = MyModel()
404	# 窗口调小便于演示;sigma_factor=2 比默认 6 灵敏
405	optim = SkipStepAdamWConfig(rolling_interval_length=4, sigma_factor=2).build(model)
406	
407	def train_step(loss_spike=False, grad_spike=False):
408	    optim.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
409	    loss = model(torch.randint(0, 128, (4, 8))).sum()
410	    loss.backward()
411	    if grad_spike:                            # 模拟梯度爆炸:把梯度放大 1e4 倍
412	        for p in model.parameters():
413	            if p.grad is not None:
414	                p.grad.mul_(1e4)
415	    # 模拟 TransformerTrainModule 的时序契约(4.3):先裁剪拿范数,再喂两个信号,最后 step
416	    grad_norm = nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
417	    optim.latest_grad_norm = grad_norm.detach()
418	    optim.latest_loss = torch.tensor(1e9) if loss_spike else loss.detach()
419	    before = model.fc1.weight.detach().clone()
420	    optim.step()
421	    inner_step = next(iter(optim.state.values()))["step"].item()
422	    moved = (model.fc1.weight - before).abs().max().item()
423	    print(f"loss={optim.latest_loss.item():>12.4f}  gnorm={optim.latest_grad_norm.item():8.4f}  "
424	          f"skipped={optim.step_skipped.item():.0f}  window={len(optim._losses)}  "
425	          f"inner_step={inner_step:.0f}  |Δw|={moved:.2e}")
426	
427	for i in range(6):
428	    train_step()                              # 热身 + 正常步
429	print("---- 注入 loss spike ----");  train_step(loss_spike=True)
430	print("---- 注入 grad spike ----");  train_step(grad_spike=True)
431	for i in range(3):
432	    train_step()                              # 恢复正常
433	```
434	
435	**操作步骤**:
436	
437	1. 把脚本存到仓库外的任意目录,`python skip_step_demo.py` 运行。
438	2. 先做对照实验:把 `sigma_factor=2` 改回默认 `6`,再跑一次。
439	3. 再运行官方单测做交叉验证:`pytest -v src/test/optim/skip_step_optimizer_test.py`。
440	
441	**需要观察的现象**:
442	
443	- 热身阶段(窗口样本数 < `max(2, 4//2)=2`)`skipped` 恒为 0;
444	- 注入 loss spike 的那一步 `skipped=1`,且 `|Δw|≈0`、`inner_step` 不前进——整步是严格 no-op;
445	- 注入 grad spike 的那一步同样 `skipped=1`(梯度范数通道触发);
446	- spike 之后的正常步 `skipped=0`(检测是单边的,远低于均值不跳);
447	- `sigma_factor=6` 时,若你的正常 loss 波动很小,spike 仍被跳过(离群 1e9 太远)。
448	
449	**预期结果**:跳步发生当且仅当注入步;`optim._losses` 长度最终不超过 `rolling_interval_length + 1 = 5`;被跳步的 `inner_step` 与上一步相同。若现象与预期不符,优先检查你是否在 `optim.step()` **之前**设置了 `latest_loss`/`latest_grad_norm`(契约见 4.1.3)。全部输出数值随环境不同,以「跳/不跳的布尔模式」为准。
450	
451	## 6. 本讲小结
452	
453	- **SkipStepOptimizer** 用滚动窗口(默认 128 步)的均值 + \(k\sigma\)(默认 6σ)单边判据检测 loss 与梯度范数异常,判定结果 `step_factor` 是留在设备上的 0/1 张量,全程无 host-device 同步,保证各 rank 决策一致。
454	- **SkipStepAdamW** 把 `step_factor` 织进更新公式的每一项(权重衰减、两个动量、更新量、内部 step 计数),跳步是数学上严格的 no-op;`step_increment_bugfix` 记录了内部计数不递增导致有效 lr 偏高 2.2 倍的历史 bug。OLMo-2/OLMo-3 全部官方配方默认使用它。
455	- **时序契约**:裁剪发生在 `TrainModule.optim_step()` 内、`optim.step()` 之前;`latest_loss` 在 `train_batch` 里提前跨 rank 归约,`latest_grad_norm` 复用裁剪算出的(裁剪前)总范数;两者必须先于 `step()` 就位。`OLMoDDPOptimizer` 则把裁剪、喂信号、跳步全部内化进 `step()`。
456	- **梯度范数的正确性**是多维并行下的难点:分片量按平方和归约、复制量直取、PP/EP 各自归并,`clamp+无条件乘` 的施加方式同样是为了避免同步。
457	- **grad_debug** 的 `debug_nan_inf_grad_norm()` 以「有限即零开销早退、非有限才逐参数体检」的模式定位 NaN/Inf 元凶,由 `OLMO_DDP_DEBUG_NONFINITE_GRAD` 等环境变量在 OLMoDDPOptimizer 路径触发;跳步对付有限尖峰,有限性断言 + 诊断对付硬故障。
458	
459	## 7. 下一步学习建议
460	
461	- **u6-l1(Trainer 训练循环剖析)**:`optim_step` / `zero_grads` 如何被主循环调度、`optim` 命名空间的指标(`total grad norm`、`step skipped`)如何被收集与跨 rank 归约——本讲的时序图将被放进完整训练循环的上下文。
462	- **u7-l1(数据并行)**:`_clip_grad_norm` 里 FSDP 分支与 DTensor `full_tensor()` 归约的深层原因,将在 FSDP/HSDP 的分片机制中展开。
463	- **延伸阅读**:`src/olmo_core/optim/moe_optimizer.py` 中 `OLMoDDPOptimizer.step()`(L1262 起)是「梯度搬运 + 裁剪 + 有限性检查 + 跳步 + 融合更新」一体化的完整样本,配合 u3-l5(MoE)阅读收获最大;`_assert_finite_async` 的异步断言机制也值得顺带一看。

batch["labels"] = get_labels(batch, label_ignore_index=self.label_ignore_index)

        # Calculate how many tokens will be used in the loss.
        batch_num_tokens = batch["labels"].numel()
        batch_num_tokens_per_instance = batch["labels"].shape[1]
        batch_num_tokens_for_loss = move_to_device(
            (batch["labels"] != self.label_ignore_index).sum(), self.device
        )

        # Record percentage of masked labels.
        self.record_metric(
            "train/masked labels (%)",  # just a proportion, not a percentage
            (batch_num_tokens - batch_num_tokens_for_loss) / batch_num_tokens,
            ReduceType.mean,
        )

        # Record percentage of masked instances.
        if (instance_mask := batch.get("instance_mask")) is not None:
            self.record_metric(
                "train/masked instances (%)",  # just a proportion, not a percentage
                (~instance_mask).float().mean(),
                ReduceType.mean,
            )

            # WARN: When we mask out instances with the instance filter, we count those tokens
            # for the loss anyways. They will count as tokens with a zero loss. This means we
            # get an artificially *low* loss for these batches. But it is really hard (and slow)
            # to do this properly in a distributed setup. We add back in the full number of tokens
            # for the loss so that each rank contributes to the loss calculation fairly.
            batch_num_tokens_for_loss += (~instance_mask).sum() * batch_num_tokens_per_instance

        # Normalize by the global number of loss tokens rather than the local one, so that the
        # objective is the mean over all loss tokens in the global batch regardless of how they're
        # distributed across DP ranks. Since gradients get averaged over DP ranks, we divide the
        # global count by the DP world size. NOTE: CP/TP ranks see the same (unsharded) labels here,
        # so they're not part of the DP process group sum and the LM head already accounts for them.
        if is_distributed() and self.dp_config is not None:
            dist.all_reduce(batch_num_tokens_for_loss, group=self.dp_process_group)
            batch_num_tokens_for_loss = batch_num_tokens_for_loss.clamp_min(1) / get_world_size(
                self.dp_process_group
            )
        else:
            batch_num_tokens_for_loss = batch_num_tokens_for_loss.clamp_min(1)

        # Batch losses to record.
        ce_batch_loss = move_to_device(torch.tensor(0.0), self.device)
        z_batch_loss: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
        if self.z_loss_multiplier is not None:
            z_batch_loss = move_to_device(torch.tensor(0.0), self.device)

        # Split into micro-batches.
        if self.rank_microbatch_size < (seq_len := batch["input_ids"].shape[1]):
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Microbatch size ({self.rank_microbatch_size}) is too small relative to sequence length ({seq_len})"
            )
        micro_batches = split_batch(batch, self.rank_microbatch_size // seq_len)
        num_micro_batches = len(micro_batches)

        # Train one micro-batch at a time.
        for micro_batch_idx, micro_batch in enumerate(micro_batches):
            with self._train_microbatch_context(micro_batch_idx, num_micro_batches):
                input_ids, labels, model_kwargs = self._prepare_batch(micro_batch)

                # Run forward pass, get losses.
                _, loss, ce_loss, z_loss = self.model_forward(
                    input_ids,
                    labels=labels,
                    ignore_index=self.label_ignore_index,
                    loss_reduction="sum",
                    z_loss_multiplier=self.z_loss_multiplier,
                    loss_div_factor=batch_num_tokens_for_loss,
                    return_logits=False,
                    **model_kwargs,
                )

                # Update total batch CE and Z loss.
                ce_batch_loss += get_local_tensor(ce_loss.detach())
                del ce_loss
                if z_batch_loss is not None:
                    assert z_loss is not None
                    z_batch_loss += get_local_tensor(z_loss.detach())
                    del z_loss

                # Run backward pass.
                loss.backward()

        del batch  # In case this helps with memory utilization.

        self.model.post_batch(dry_run=dry_run)

        if dry_run:
            self.model.reset_auxiliary_metrics()
            return

        # Record loss metrics.
        if isinstance(self.optim, SkipStepOptimizer):
            # Need to reduce the loss right away for the SkipStepOptimizer.
            if is_distributed():
                ce_batch_loss.div_(self._reduce_divide_factor)
                dist.all_reduce(ce_batch_loss)
                ce_batch_loss.div_(self.world_size)
                ce_batch_loss.mul_(self._reduce_divide_factor)
            self.record_ce_loss(ce_batch_loss)
            self.optim.latest_loss = ce_batch_loss
        else:
            self.record_ce_loss(ce_batch_loss, ReduceType.mean)
        if z_batch_loss is not None:
            assert self.z_loss_multiplier is not None
            self.record_metric(
                "Z loss",
                z_batch_loss,
                ReduceType.mean,
                namespace="train",
            )
            self.record_metric(
                "Z loss unscaled",
                z_batch_loss / self.z_loss_multiplier,
                ReduceType.mean,
                namespace="train",
            )

        # And additional metrics.
        for metric_name, (metric_val, reduction) in self.model.compute_auxiliary_metrics(
            reset=True
        ).items():
            self.record_metric(
                metric_name,
                metric_val,
                reduction,
                namespace="train",
            )

    def eval_batch(
        self, batch: Dict[str, Any], labels: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> Union[torch.Tensor, LMOutputWithLoss]:
        # CP and TP are supported for PPL evals (LMEvaluator) since they only need per-token
        # CE loss. Downstream evals that require full logits will fail naturally if attempted
        # with CP or TP.

        input_ids, labels, model_kwargs = self._prepare_batch(batch, labels)

        # When using CP/TP, shard the label_mask along the sequence dimension to match the
        # sharded ce_loss output shape. CP shards first (S -> S/CP), then TP shards further
        # (S/CP -> S/(CP*TP)).
        if self.cp_enabled and "label_mask" in model_kwargs:
            assert self.model._cp_load_balancer is not None
            (label_mask,) = self.model._cp_load_balancer.batch_shard(
                inputs=[model_kwargs["label_mask"]],
                seq_dims=[1],
                pad_values=[0],
            )
            model_kwargs["label_mask"] = label_mask.to(torch.bool)

        if self.tp_enabled and "label_mask" in model_kwargs:
            tp_mesh = self.model._tp_mesh
            assert tp_mesh is not None
            chunks = model_kwargs["label_mask"].chunk(tp_mesh.size(), dim=1)
            model_kwargs["label_mask"] = chunks[tp_mesh.get_local_rank()]

        self._set_model_mode("eval")

        with self._eval_batch_context():
            output = self.model_forward(
                input_ids,
                labels=labels,
                ignore_index=self.label_ignore_index,
                loss_reduction="none",
                return_logits=False if (self.cp_enabled or self.tp_enabled) else None,
                **model_kwargs,
            )

        if self.tp_enabled and isinstance(output, LMOutputWithLoss):
            output = output._replace(ce_loss=get_local_tensor(output.ce_loss))

        return output

    def optim_step(self):
        assert self.optim is not None, "optim_step() is not available in eval_only mode"
        # Maybe clip gradients.
        if self.max_grad_norm is not None:
            grad_norm = self._clip_grad_norm(self.max_grad_norm)
            # NOTE: grad norm is already reduced over ranks, so we set `reduce_type` to `None`.
            self.trainer.record_metric(
                "total grad norm", grad_norm, reduce_type=None, namespace="optim"
            )
            if isinstance(self.optim, SkipStepOptimizer):
                self.optim.latest_grad_norm = grad_norm

        # Maybe adjust learning rate.
        if self.scheduler is not None:
            for group_idx, group in enumerate(self.optim.param_groups):
                new_lr = self.scheduler.set_lr(group, self.trainer)
                self.trainer.record_metric(f"LR (group {group_idx})", new_lr, namespace="optim")

        # Step optimizer.
        self.optim.step()
        if isinstance(self.optim, SkipStepOptimizer):
            self.record_metric("step skipped", self.optim.step_skipped, namespace="optim")

        self.model.post_optim_step()

    def zero_grads(self):
        assert self.optim is not None, "zero_grads() is not available in eval_only mode"
        self.optim.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

    def model_forward(
        self, input_ids: torch.Tensor, labels: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None, **kwargs
    ) -> Union[torch.Tensor, LMOutputWithLoss]:
        """
        Run a forward pass on a micro-batch, returning the logits.
        """
        with self._model_forward_context():
            return self.model(input_ids, labels=labels, **kwargs)

    @lru_cache
    def num_flops_per_token(self, seq_len: int) -> Optional[int]:
        try:
            return self.model.num_flops_per_token(seq_len)
        except NotImplementedError as ex:
            warn_once(f"Unable to estimate num flops per token: {ex}")

            state_dict["optim"] = dist_cp_sd.get_optimizer_state_dict(
                self.model, self.optim, options=sd_options
            )
        return state_dict

    def _clip_grad_norm(
        self, max_grad_norm: float, norm_type: float = 2.0, foreach: Optional[bool] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        if isinstance(self.model, FSDP):
            return self.model.clip_grad_norm_(max_grad_norm)

        # Adapted from https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/blob/2a4437014e66bcf88a3f0419b816266e6326d539/torchtitan/utils.py#L348

        parameters = [p for p in self.model.parameters()]
        grads = [p.grad for p in parameters if p.grad is not None]

        total_norm = nn.utils.get_total_norm(
            grads, norm_type=norm_type, error_if_nonfinite=False, foreach=foreach
        )

        # If total_norm is a DTensor, the placements must be `torch.distributed._tensor.ops.math_ops._NormPartial`.
        # We can simply reduce the DTensor to get the total norm in this tensor's process group
        # and then convert it to a local tensor.
        # NOTE: It has two purposes:
        #       1. to make sure the total norm is computed correctly when PP is used (see below)
        #       2. to return a reduced total_norm tensor whose .item() would return the correct value
        if isinstance(total_norm, DTensor):
            # Will reach here if any non-PP parallelism is used.
            # If only using PP, total_norm will be a local tensor.
            total_norm = total_norm.full_tensor()

        torch.nn.utils.clip_grads_with_norm_(parameters, max_grad_norm, total_norm, foreach=foreach)
        return total_norm

    def _prepare_batch(
        self, batch: Dict[str, Any], labels: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor], Dict[str, Any]]:
        input_ids = batch.pop("input_ids")
        labels = labels if labels is not None else batch.pop("labels", None)
        if "doc_lens" in batch and "max_doc_lens" in batch:
            log_once(log, "intra-document masking enabled")
        return input_ids, labels, batch

    def _set_model_mode(self, mode: Literal["train", "eval"]):

21	        :meth:`step()`.
22

24	        the :data:`latest_loss` and :data:`latest_grad_norm` whenever its optimizer is a subclass of
25	        :class:`SkipStepOptimizer`.

29	        syncs. You can use :meth:`get_step_factor()` within your :meth:`step()` method to do this.
30	        See the implementation of :class:`SkipStepLion` for an example.

35	        params: ParamsT,

37	        rolling_interval_length: int = 128,

import pytest
import torch
from torch import nn

from olmo_core.optim import SkipStepAdamWConfig
from olmo_core.testing import DEVICES


class MyModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.wte = nn.Embedding(1024, 16)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(16, 32)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(32, 16)

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        x = self.wte(x)
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = torch.relu(x)
        return self.fc2(x)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("device", DEVICES)
def test_skip_step_optimizer(device: torch.device):
    """Test that skip step optimizer skips steps with outlier losses."""
    model = MyModel().to(device)
    optim = SkipStepAdamWConfig(rolling_interval_length=2, sigma_factor=1).build(model)

    # Normal step - should not skip
    optim.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    loss = model(torch.randint(0, 128, (4, 8), device=device)).sum()
    optim.latest_loss = loss.detach()
    loss.backward()
    optim.step()
    assert torch.equal(optim.step_skipped.cpu().detach(), torch.tensor(False))

    # Outlier step - should skip
    optim.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    loss = model(torch.randint(0, 128, (4, 8), device=device)).sum()
    optim.latest_loss = torch.tensor(1e9, device=device)  # Outlier loss
    loss.backward()
    optim.step()
    assert torch.equal(optim.step_skipped.cpu().detach(), torch.tensor(True))

    # Another normal step
    optim.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    loss = model(torch.randint(0, 128, (4, 8), device=device)).sum()
    optim.latest_loss = loss.detach()
    loss.backward()
    optim.step()
    assert torch.equal(optim.step_skipped.cpu().detach(), torch.tensor(False))

12	def adamw_step(
13	    p: torch.Tensor,
14	    grad: torch.Tensor,
15	    *,
16	    lr: float,
17	    betas: Tuple[float, float],
18	    eps: float,
19	    weight_decay: float,
20	    exp_avg: torch.Tensor,
21	    exp_avg_sq: torch.Tensor,
22	    step: torch.Tensor,
23	    step_factor: torch.Tensor,
24	    step_increment_bugfix: bool = True,
25	):
26	    beta1, beta2 = betas
27	
28	    # Perform step weight decay.
29	    p.mul_(1 - step_factor * (lr * weight_decay))
30	
31	    # Decay the first and second moment running average coefficient.
32	    exp_avg.lerp_(grad.type_as(exp_avg), (step_factor * (1 - beta1)).type_as(exp_avg))
33	    exp_avg_sq.mul_(1 - step_factor * (1 - beta2))
34	    exp_avg_sq.add_(step_factor * grad * grad, alpha=1 - beta2)
35	
36	    bias_correction1 = 1 - beta1 ** (step + 1)
37	    bias_correction2 = 1 - beta2 ** (step + 1)
38	
39	    step_size = lr / bias_correction1
40	
41	    denom = (exp_avg_sq.sqrt() / bias_correction2.sqrt()).add_(eps)
42	
43	    update = -step_size * torch.div(exp_avg, denom)
44	    update.mul_(step_factor)
45	    p.add_(update)
46	    if step_increment_bugfix:
47	        step.add_(step_factor)

50	def foreach_adamw_step(
51	    params: list[torch.Tensor],
52	    grads: list[torch.Tensor],
53	    exp_avgs: list[torch.Tensor],
54	    exp_avg_sqs: list[torch.Tensor],
55	    steps: list[torch.Tensor],
56	    *,
57	    lr: float,
58	    betas: Tuple[float, float],
59	    eps: float,
60	    weight_decay: float,
61	    step_factor: torch.Tensor,
62	    step_increment_bugfix: bool = True,
63	):
64	    """Perform a single AdamW update with multi-tensor (*foreach*) kernels."""
65	    if not params:
66	        return  # nothing to do
67	
68	    beta1, beta2 = betas
69	
70	    # Perform step weight decay.
71	    torch._foreach_mul_(params, 1 - step_factor * (lr * weight_decay))
72	
73	    grads = [g.type_as(ea) for g, ea in zip(grads, exp_avgs)]
74	
75	    # Decay the first and second moment running average coefficient.
76	    # foreach_lerp_ has issues when DTensor is enabled (see https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/132017).
77	    # Implement the lerp(a, b, w) = a + w * (b - a) with basic _foreach_mul_/add_ ops instead:
78	    w1 = step_factor * (1 - beta1)
79	    torch._foreach_mul_(exp_avgs, 1.0 - w1)
80	    torch._foreach_add_(exp_avgs, torch._foreach_mul(grads, w1))
81	
82	    grad_squares = torch._foreach_mul(grads, grads)
83	
84	    w2 = step_factor * (1 - beta2)
85	    torch._foreach_mul_(exp_avg_sqs, 1.0 - w2)
86	    torch._foreach_add_(exp_avg_sqs, torch._foreach_mul(grad_squares, w2))
87	
88	    steps_t = torch.stack(steps)
89	    bias_corrections1 = 1 - torch.pow(beta1, steps_t + 1)
90	    bias_corrections2 = 1 - torch.pow(beta2, steps_t + 1)
91	
92	    step_sizes = lr / bias_corrections1
93	
94	    denoms = torch._foreach_sqrt(exp_avg_sqs)
95	    torch._foreach_div_(denoms, bias_corrections2.sqrt().unbind())
96	    torch._foreach_add_(denoms, eps)
97	
98	    updates = torch._foreach_div(exp_avgs, denoms)
99	    torch._foreach_mul_(updates, (-step_factor * step_sizes).unbind())
100	    torch._foreach_add_(params, updates)
101	    if step_increment_bugfix:
102	        torch._foreach_add_(steps, [step_factor] * len(steps))

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import ClassVar, Optional, Tuple, Type, Union

import torch

from ..config import DType
from ..distributed.utils import get_local_tensor
from .config import OptimConfig
from .skip_step_optimizer import SkipStepOptimizer


def adamw_step(
    p: torch.Tensor,
    grad: torch.Tensor,
    *,
    lr: float,
    betas: Tuple[float, float],
    eps: float,
    weight_decay: float,
    exp_avg: torch.Tensor,
    exp_avg_sq: torch.Tensor,
    step: torch.Tensor,
    step_factor: torch.Tensor,
    step_increment_bugfix: bool = True,
):
    beta1, beta2 = betas

    # Perform step weight decay.
    p.mul_(1 - step_factor * (lr * weight_decay))

    # Decay the first and second moment running average coefficient.
    exp_avg.lerp_(grad.type_as(exp_avg), (step_factor * (1 - beta1)).type_as(exp_avg))
    exp_avg_sq.mul_(1 - step_factor * (1 - beta2))
    exp_avg_sq.add_(step_factor * grad * grad, alpha=1 - beta2)

    bias_correction1 = 1 - beta1 ** (step + 1)
    bias_correction2 = 1 - beta2 ** (step + 1)

    step_size = lr / bias_correction1

    denom = (exp_avg_sq.sqrt() / bias_correction2.sqrt()).add_(eps)

    update = -step_size * torch.div(exp_avg, denom)
    update.mul_(step_factor)
    p.add_(update)
    if step_increment_bugfix:
        step.add_(step_factor)


def foreach_adamw_step(
    params: list[torch.Tensor],
    grads: list[torch.Tensor],
    exp_avgs: list[torch.Tensor],
    exp_avg_sqs: list[torch.Tensor],
    steps: list[torch.Tensor],
    *,
    lr: float,
    betas: Tuple[float, float],
    eps: float,
    weight_decay: float,
    step_factor: torch.Tensor,
    step_increment_bugfix: bool = True,
):
    """Perform a single AdamW update with multi-tensor (*foreach*) kernels."""
    if not params:
        return  # nothing to do

    beta1, beta2 = betas

    # Perform step weight decay.
    torch._foreach_mul_(params, 1 - step_factor * (lr * weight_decay))

    grads = [g.type_as(ea) for g, ea in zip(grads, exp_avgs)]

    # Decay the first and second moment running average coefficient.
    # foreach_lerp_ has issues when DTensor is enabled (see https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/132017).
    # Implement the lerp(a, b, w) = a + w * (b - a) with basic _foreach_mul_/add_ ops instead:
    w1 = step_factor * (1 - beta1)
    torch._foreach_mul_(exp_avgs, 1.0 - w1)
    torch._foreach_add_(exp_avgs, torch._foreach_mul(grads, w1))

    grad_squares = torch._foreach_mul(grads, grads)

    w2 = step_factor * (1 - beta2)
    torch._foreach_mul_(exp_avg_sqs, 1.0 - w2)
    torch._foreach_add_(exp_avg_sqs, torch._foreach_mul(grad_squares, w2))

    steps_t = torch.stack(steps)
    bias_corrections1 = 1 - torch.pow(beta1, steps_t + 1)
    bias_corrections2 = 1 - torch.pow(beta2, steps_t + 1)

    step_sizes = lr / bias_corrections1

    denoms = torch._foreach_sqrt(exp_avg_sqs)
    torch._foreach_div_(denoms, bias_corrections2.sqrt().unbind())
    torch._foreach_add_(denoms, eps)

    updates = torch._foreach_div(exp_avgs, denoms)
    torch._foreach_mul_(updates, (-step_factor * step_sizes).unbind())
    torch._foreach_add_(params, updates)
    if step_increment_bugfix:
        torch._foreach_add_(steps, [step_factor] * len(steps))


class SkipStepAdamW(SkipStepOptimizer):
    """
    A "skip step" version of :class:`AdamW`.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        params,
        lr: float = 1e-3,
        betas: Tuple[float, float] = (0.9, 0.999),
        eps: float = 1e-8,
        weight_decay: float = 1e-2,
        rolling_interval_length: int = 128,
        sigma_factor: int = 6,
        dtype: Optional[Union[torch.dtype, DType]] = None,
        foreach: bool = False,
        step_increment_bugfix: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        assert lr >= 0.0
        assert all([0.0 <= beta <= 1.0 for beta in betas])
        defaults = dict(lr=lr, betas=betas, eps=eps, weight_decay=weight_decay)
        super().__init__(
            params,
            defaults,
            rolling_interval_length=rolling_interval_length,
            sigma_factor=sigma_factor,
        )
        if isinstance(dtype, DType):
            dtype = dtype.as_pt()
        self.dtype = dtype
        self.foreach = foreach
        self.stepfix = step_increment_bugfix
        self._step_skipped: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None

    @property
    def step_skipped(self) -> torch.Tensor:
        if self._step_skipped is not None:
            return self._step_skipped
        else:
            return torch.tensor(0.0)

    @torch.no_grad()
    def step(self, closure=None) -> None:
        if self.foreach:
            self._step_foreach(closure)
        else:
            self._step(closure)

    def _step(self, closure=None) -> None:
        if closure is not None:
            with torch.enable_grad():
                closure()

        step_factor = self.get_step_factor()
        self._step_skipped = 1 - step_factor
        for group in self.param_groups:
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue

                state = self.state[p]
                if len(state) == 0:
                    state["step"] = torch.zeros((), dtype=torch.float32, device=p.device)
                    state["exp_avg"] = torch.zeros_like(p, dtype=self.dtype)
                    state["exp_avg_sq"] = torch.zeros_like(p, dtype=self.dtype)

                adamw_step(
                    get_local_tensor(p),
                    get_local_tensor(p.grad),
                    lr=group["lr"],
                    betas=group["betas"],
                    eps=group["eps"],
                    weight_decay=group["weight_decay"],
                    exp_avg=get_local_tensor(state["exp_avg"]),
                    exp_avg_sq=get_local_tensor(state["exp_avg_sq"]),
                    step=state["step"],
                    step_factor=step_factor,
                    step_increment_bugfix=self.stepfix,
                )

    def _step_foreach(self, closure=None) -> None:
        if closure is not None:
            with torch.enable_grad():
                closure()

        step_factor = self.get_step_factor()
        self._step_skipped = 1 - step_factor
        for group in self.param_groups:
            params_with_grad: list[torch.Tensor] = []
            grads: list[torch.Tensor] = []
            exp_avgs: list[torch.Tensor] = []
            exp_avg_sqs: list[torch.Tensor] = []
            steps_list = []  # create list outside loops

            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue

                state = self.state[p]
                if len(state) == 0:
                    state["step"] = torch.zeros((), dtype=torch.float32, device=p.device)
                    state["exp_avg"] = torch.zeros_like(p, dtype=self.dtype)
                    state["exp_avg_sq"] = torch.zeros_like(p, dtype=self.dtype)

                params_with_grad.append(get_local_tensor(p))
                grads.append(get_local_tensor(p.grad))
                exp_avgs.append(get_local_tensor(state["exp_avg"]))
                exp_avg_sqs.append(get_local_tensor(state["exp_avg_sq"]))
                steps_list.append(state["step"])

            if not params_with_grad:
                continue  # nothing to update in this group

            foreach_adamw_step(
                params_with_grad,
                grads,
                exp_avgs,
                exp_avg_sqs,
                steps_list,
                lr=group["lr"],
                betas=group["betas"],
                eps=group["eps"],
                weight_decay=group["weight_decay"],
                step_factor=step_factor,
                step_increment_bugfix=self.stepfix,
            )


@OptimConfig.register("adamw")
@dataclass
class AdamWConfig(OptimConfig[torch.optim.AdamW]):
    """
    Configuration class for building an :class:`torch.optim.AdamW` optimizer.
    """

    lr: float = 1e-3
    betas: Tuple[float, float] = (0.9, 0.999)
    eps: float = 1e-8
    weight_decay: float = 1e-2
    foreach: Optional[bool] = None
    fused: Optional[bool] = None

    _supports_completedp: ClassVar[bool] = True

    @classmethod
    def optimizer(cls) -> Type[torch.optim.AdamW]:
        return torch.optim.AdamW


@OptimConfig.register("skip_step_adamw")
@dataclass
class SkipStepAdamWConfig(OptimConfig[SkipStepAdamW]):
    """
    Configuration class for building a :class:`SkipStepAdamW` optimizer.
    """

    lr: float = 1e-3
    betas: Tuple[float, float] = (0.9, 0.999)
    eps: float = 1e-8
    weight_decay: float = 1e-2
    dtype: Optional[DType] = None
    foreach: bool = True
    """
    Whether to use multi-tensor (*foreach*) kernels for the AdamW update.
    Faster than the non-foreach version.
    """

    step_increment_bugfix: bool = True
    """
    Whether or not to fix the step-incrementing bug discovered in SkipStepAdamW.

    If this flag is set to False, the step will not be incremented, which
    gives the optimizer an effective lr that is 2.2x higher than the specified lr,
    and no bias correction is applied.
    """

    rolling_interval_length: int = 128
    """
    The length of the rolling interval to use for computing the mean and standard deviation of the loss.
    """

    sigma_factor: int = 6
    """
    The number of standard deviations above the mean loss to skip a step.
    """

    _supports_completedp: ClassVar[bool] = True

    @classmethod
    def optimizer(cls) -> Type[SkipStepAdamW]:
        return SkipStepAdamW

`get_reduce_divide_factor` returns the largest power-of-2 factor `f` such that `world_size % f == 0 and world_size/f > f` — i.e., a factor close to sqrt(world_size), used to make the SUM-then-divide mean reduction numerically safer (dividing by a small power of 2 before all_reduce keeps intermediates in a safe range... actually the pattern div_by_factor → all_reduce → div_by_world_size → mul_by_factor implements `mean = sum(x)/world_size` as `sum(x/f) / world_size * f`, where f is a power of 2 so division is exact in floating point). So describing it as "数值安全因子" (a power-of-2 pre-scaling that makes the division exact / keeps the reduction numerically well-behaved) is accurate. Good — the standard trick for numerically-safe distributed mean.

**信号①:train_batch 里提前归约 loss**。[train_module.py:L515-L523](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L515-L523):`isinstance(self.optim, SkipStepOptimizer)` 分支中,先把 `ce_batch_loss` 除以 2 的幂的数值安全因子 `_reduce_divide_factor`、`dist.all_reduce` 求和、除以 world size、再把安全因子乘回(注释写明「Need to reduce the loss right away for the SkipStepOptimizer」),然后才 `self.optim.latest_loss = ce_batch_loss`。普通优化器则走 [L525](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L525) 的延迟归约路径(`ReduceType.mean`,日志时才归约)——跳步优化器等不到那时。

`latest_loss` 的语义在本轮 #957 之后变得更准了:前向计算 CE 时除以的 `loss_div_factor`([train_module.py:L490](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L490))不再是本 rank 的 loss token 数,而是**全局 loss token 数的 DP 份额**——token 计数先在 DP 进程组内 `all_reduce` 求和,再除以 DP world size 并 `clamp_min(1)`([train_module.py:L451-L462](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L451-L462),单进程时退化为本地计数 `clamp_min(1)`)。因此信号① 归约完成后,`latest_loss` 恰是「全局 batch 内所有参与损失的 token 的平均 CE」(**token 加权**),而非修复前「各 rank 本地均值的平均」(**rank 加权**)。SFT 场景下 label masking 使各 rank 有效 token 数不均衡时,token 数极少的 rank 的局部波动不再被等权计入,6σ 检测窗口里的统计量含义保持稳定。为什么「除以 DP world size 的全局计数 + DP 梯度平均」恰好等价于在全局 batch 上直接求 token 均值,完整推导与新增的分布式测试见 u6-l2。

lines: `latest_loss` 的语义在本轮 #957 之后变得更准了:前向计算 CE 时除以的 `loss_div_factor`([train_module.py:L490](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L490))不再是本 rank 的 loss token 数,而是**全局 loss token 数的 DP 份额**——token 计数先在 DP 进程组内 `all_reduce` 求和,再除以 DP world size 并 `clamp_min(1)`([train_module.py:L451-L462](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L451-L462),单进程时退化为本地计数 `clamp_min(1)`)。因此信号① 归约完成后,`latest_loss` 恰是「全局 batch 内所有参与损失的 token 的平均 CE」(**token 加权**),而非修复前「各 rank 本地均值的平均」(**rank 加权**)。SFT 场景下 label masking 使各 rank 有效 token 数不均衡时,token 数极少的 rank 的局部波动不再被等权计入,6σ 检测窗口里的统计量含义保持稳定。为什么「除以 DP world size 的全局计数 + DP 梯度平均」恰好等价于在全局 batch 上直接求 token 均值,完整推导与新增的分布式测试见 u6-l2。

-**时序契约的主战场 `optim_step()`**。[train_module.py:L583-L606](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L583-L606) 完整对应上面流程图的 ①-⑥:[L586-L591](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L586-L591) 裁剪并记录(注释强调范数已跨 rank 归约,指标 `reduce_type=None` 防止二次归约);[L592-L593](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L592-L593) 写入信号②;[L602-L604](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L602-L604) step 之后把 `optim.step_skipped` 记录为命名空间 `optim` 下的 **"step skipped" 指标**——训练日志里看到它变成 1,就知道检测器拦下了一步。

+**时序契约的主战场 `optim_step()`**。[train_module.py:L596-L619](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L596-L619) 完整对应上面流程图的 ①-⑥:[L599-L604](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L599-L604) 裁剪并记录(注释强调范数已跨 rank 归约,指标 `reduce_type=None` 防止二次归约);[L605-L606](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L605-L606) 写入信号②;[L615-L617](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L615-L617) step 之后把 `optim.step_skipped` 记录为命名空间 `optim` 下的 **"step skipped" 指标**——训练日志里看到它变成 1,就知道检测器拦下了一步。

**裁剪实现 `_clip_grad_norm()`**。[train_module.py:L683-L710](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L683-L710) 分两路:FSDP 模型直接委托 [`model.clip_grad_norm_`](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L686-L687)(FSDP 框架自己懂分片);否则用改编自 torchtitan 的两段式——`nn.utils.get_total_norm` 算范数([L694-L696](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L694-L696)),若是 DTensor 则 `full_tensor()` 归约([L704-L707](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L704-L707),注释说明这也是为了让 PP 场景下 `.item()` 拿到正确值),最后 `clip_grads_with_norm_` 施加裁剪([L709](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L709))。**返回的是裁剪前的总范数**——正好就是检测器要的梯度范数信号。

lines: - **SkipStepOptimizer** 用滚动窗口(默认 128 步)的均值 + \(k\sigma\)(默认 6σ)单边判据检测 loss 与梯度范数异常,判定结果 `step_factor` 是留在设备上的 0/1 张量,全程无 host-device 同步,保证各 rank 决策一致。
- **SkipStepAdamW** 把 `step_factor` 织进更新公式的每一项(权重衰减、两个动量、更新量、内部 step 计数),跳步是数学上严格的 no-op;`step_increment_bugfix` 记录了内部计数不递增导致有效 lr 偏高 2.2 倍的历史 bug。OLMo-2/OLMo-3 全部官方配方默认使用它。

-- **时序契约**:裁剪发生在 `TrainModule.optim_step()` 内、`optim.step()` 之前;`latest_loss` 在 `train_batch` 里提前跨 rank 归约,`latest_grad_norm` 复用裁剪算出的(裁剪前)总范数;两者必须先于 `step()` 就位。`OLMoDDPOptimizer` 则把裁剪、喂信号、跳步全部内化进 `step()`。

+- **时序契约**:裁剪发生在 `TrainModule.optim_step()` 内、`optim.step()` 之前;`latest_loss` 在 `train_batch` 里提前跨 rank 归约(#957 起其分母是 DP 组内 all-reduce 得到的全局 loss token 数,即 token 加权的全局均值),`latest_grad_norm` 复用裁剪算出的(裁剪前)总范数;两者必须先于 `step()` 就位。`OLMoDDPOptimizer` 则把裁剪、喂信号、跳步全部内化进 `step()`。
- **梯度范数的正确性**是多维并行下的难点:分片量按平方和归约、复制量直取、PP/EP 各自归并,`clamp+无条件乘` 的施加方式同样是为了避免同步。
- **grad_debug** 的 `debug_nan_inf_grad_norm()` 以「有限即零开销早退、非有限才逐参数体检」的模式定位 NaN/Inf 元凶,由 `OLMO_DDP_DEBUG_NONFINITE_GRAD` 等环境变量在 OLMoDDPOptimizer 路径触发;跳步对付有限尖峰,有限性断言 + 诊断对付硬故障。

file.content:
OLMo-core 的梯度裁剪**不是优化器的构造参数**,而是发生在 `TrainModule.optim_step()` 里、`optim.step()` 之前的独立一步。对跳步优化器而言,裁剪还顺带生产了检测器需要的第二路信号:`latest_grad_norm`。

于是形成一条严格的时序契约:

```
train_batch():
  前向 → loss.backward()
  若 optim 是 SkipStepOptimizer:
      先把 loss 跨 rank 归约成全局均值 → optim.latest_loss   ← 信号①
optim_step():
  ① 若设了 max_grad_norm:计算总梯度范数并裁剪
  ② 记录 "total grad norm" 指标
  ③ 若 optim 是 SkipStepOptimizer:optim.latest_grad_norm = 裁剪前范数  ← 信号②
  ④ 调度器为本步设定 lr(u5-l2)
  ⑤ optim.step()(内部用信号①②算 step_factor)
  ⑥ 记录 "step skipped" 指标
zero_grads():optim.zero_grad()
```

要点:两个信号都必须在 `step()` 之前就位(基类文档的硬性要求);且 loss 必须是**全局**的——各 rank 拿本地 loss 判定会得出不同 `step_factor`,参数立即失同步。「全局」在 #957 之后还多了一层含义:这个均值的分母是 DP 进程组内 all-reduce 得到的**全局 loss token 数**(除以 DP world size 后使用),所以它不仅是跨 rank 的平均,还是 token 加权的全局均值——SFT 下各 rank 被掩码的 token 数不同时,它与「各 rank 本地均值的平均」不再重合(详见 4.3.3 与 u6-l2)。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

裁剪本身的算法(与 2.2 公式一致):

```
total_norm = ‖所有参数梯度‖₂(跨并行维度正确归约)
clip_coef = max_grad_norm / (total_norm + 1e-6)
所有梯度 ×= clamp(clip_coef, max=1.0)     ← 无条件乘,用 clamp 避免 if 同步
```

分布式难点在「total_norm 怎么算才对」:分片(DTensor/FSDP)、复制、流水线各持有一部分梯度,必须先按分片平方和的局部和、再跨进程组归约,最后开方——TransformerTrainModule 与 OLMoDDPOptimizer 对此有各自实现。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**信号①:train_batch 里提前归约 loss**。[train_module.py:L515-L523](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L515-L523):`isinstance(self.optim, SkipStepOptimizer)` 分支中,先把 `ce_batch_loss` 除以 2 的幂的数值安全因子 `_reduce_divide_factor`、`dist.all_reduce` 求和、除以 world size、再把安全因子乘回(注释写明「Need to reduce the loss right away for the SkipStepOptimizer」),然后才 `self.optim.latest_loss = ce_batch_loss`。普通优化器则走 [L525](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L525) 的延迟归约路径(`ReduceType.mean`,日志时才归约)——跳步优化器等不到那时。

`latest_loss` 的语义在本轮 #957 之后变得更准了:前向计算 CE 时除以的 `loss_div_factor`([train_module.py:L490](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L490))不再是本 rank 的 loss token 数,而是**全局 loss token 数的 DP 份额**——token 计数先在 DP 进程组内 `all_reduce` 求和,再除以 DP world size 并 `clamp_min(1)`([train_module.py:L451-L462](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/29ab5b92b94322dbd6e28e7d39af5068b89a23dc/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L451-L462),单进程时退化为本地计数 `clamp_min(1)`)。因此信号① 归约完成后,`latest_loss` 恰是「全局 batch 内所有参与损失的 token 的平均 CE」(**token 加权**),而非修复前「各 rank 本地均值的平均」(**rank 加权**)。SFT 场景下 label masking 使各 rank 有效 token 数不均衡时,token 数极少的 rank 的局部波动不再被等权计入,6σ 检测窗口里的统计量含义保持稳定。为什么「除以 DP world size 的全局计数 + DP 梯度平均」恰好等价于在全局 batch 上直接求 token 均值,完整推导与新增的分布式测试见 u6-l2。

233	要点:两个信号都必须在 `step()` 之前就位(基类文档的硬性要求);且 loss 必须是**全局**的——各 rank 拿本地 loss 判定会得出不同 `step_factor`,参数立即失同步。「全局」在 #957 之后还多了一层含义:这个均值的分母是 DP 进程组内 all-reduce 得到的**全局 loss token 数**(除以 DP world size 后使用),所以它不仅是跨 rank 的平均,还是 token 加权的全局均值——SFT 下各 rank 被掩码的 token 数不同时,它与「各 rank 本地均值的平均」不再重合(详见 4.3.3 与 u6-l2)。

237	裁剪本身的算法(与 2.2 公式一致):
238	
239	```
240	total_norm = ‖所有参数梯度‖₂(跨并行维度正确归约)
241	clip_coef = max_grad_norm / (total_norm + 1e-6)
242	所有梯度 ×= clamp(clip_coef, max=1.0)     ← 无条件乘,用 clamp 避免 if 同步
243	```
